name: Zombie Warhorse
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-03: Escaping the Grave

generalAbilities.name: Slow
generalAbilities.description: A zombie is permanently Slowed 1 and can't use reactions.

defensiveAbilities.name: Rotting Aura
defensiveAbilities.description:
10 feet. The zombie riding horse emits an aura of rot and disease that causes wounds to fester and turn sour.

Any living creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the zombie and is not at full Hit Points takes 1d6 Untyped Damage damage (Basic DC 17 Fortitude Saving Throw save) as its wounds fester.

defensiveAbilities.name: Void Healing
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

A creature with void healing draws health from void energy rather than vitality energy. It is damaged by vitality damage and is not healed by vitality healing effects. It does not take void damage, and it is healed by void effects that heal undead.

offensiveAbilities.name: Feast
offensiveAbilities.description: The zombie warhorse Strikes with its jaws against an adjacent living creature or a creature that has died in the past hour. On a success, the zombie warhorse can feast upon the creature's flesh to heal itself. This restores 2d6 Healing Damage Hit Points.

offensiveAbilities.name: Gallop
offensiveAbilities.description: The zombie warhorse Strides twice. It has a +10-foot circumstance bonus to its Speed during these Strides.

offensiveAbilities.name: Improved Push 5 feet
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

The monster can use Push as a free action triggered by a hit with its initial attack.
